method.worker_timing: real JSON request/response including client decoding; every response byte-gated
method.runtime_gc: default; no GOGC/GOMEMLIMIT changes in retained benchmarks

memory.unit: MiB (2^20 bytes); legacy _mb field names retained
memory.go_cli: median of five per-invocation peak RSS values from wait4 ru_maxrss
memory.java: peak RSS of each entire persistent JVM process from wait4 ru_maxrss, including startup, warmup, measured iterations and shutdown
memory.worker: maximum /proc/PID/status VmHWM read after each of 40 requests, including 10 warmup requests; excludes the Python client
memory.interpretation: resident process memory, not allocated bytes or live heap; persistent-process iteration counts differ as documented

method.worker_comparison_status: Historical unequal-cache comparison; withdrawn as evidence of beating comparable Java. Go reuses extern parse templates, stock Java does not. Equivalent cached Java worker comparison pending.
